import html # Template for rendering a user profile on the web. # It contains placeholders that will be safely substituted with escaped content. PROFILE_FORMAT = ( "
\n" "

{username}

\n" "

{bio}

\n" "
{status_message}
\n" "
" ) def render_user_profile(username: str, bio: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile string for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. bio : str A user-written biography, possibly multi-sentence. status_message : str The user's current brief status update. Returns ------- str A fully escaped and formatted HTML snippet ready for inclusion in a page. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments is missing or not a string. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(username, str): raise ValueError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(bio, str): raise ValueError("bio must be a string") if not isinstance(status_message, str): raise ValueError("status_message must be a string") # Escape user-supplied content to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Render the profile using a trusted template. rendered = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status ) return rendered
